protocol.hypothesis: After prior fried-chicken/cutlet preference, twenty recent responses favor salad/poke restaurants. Scores and model parameters are never used to select inputs.
protocol.random_seed_rule: random.Random(20260923000+seed), shuffled sorted preaudited groups, then fixed splits and event-order shuffle.
protocol.prior: 40 observations:6fried-chicken+14cutlet likes and20other-food dislikes. Inverse flips only these past labels. No-history has empty past.
protocol.current: Exactly the same20 observations/order/heldout panels within each seed across3prior arms:6salad/poke likes,7fried dislikes(3chicken+4cutlet),7other-food dislikes.
protocol.heldout: 4salad/poke versus4fried(2chicken+2cutlet), no ID or observed-brand overlap with any earlier/current input in that seed.
protocol.evaluation: Frozen TemporalTasteModel versus actual baseline via unchanged research bench, full1498store ranking and actual4card selector. Pair contrast is food direction, not subtle-style accuracy. Top1/final4 require direct menu audit.

limitations: Hypothetical responses on real restaurant vectors, not real users or satisfaction ground truth.
Six seeds share restaurants and label pools; they are not six independent users.
Salad/poke restaurant choice is not a nutritional or all-nonfried assertion.
Food direction deliberately differs from prior examples; it does not prove fine-style retention.
Brand checks use observed restaurant names/known chain names, not verified legal ownership.
No-history, fried and inverse arms share identical current inputs.

provenance_metadata_completion.reason: Latest runner also verifies pool ID order and raw label-source fingerprints. Initial attempt stopped at provenance validation before offline_runtime/model scoring; these metadata fields were absent. No input/label/order/model changes.
